name: FunnelDirectory

sources.title: List Your Tool — $19 one-time listing: 30-day homepage feature, permanent directory entry, dedicated review page, up to 2 comparison pages, 4 category placements; Gumroad or Tally; 12–48h turnaround

requirements: Fit: funnel builders, email marketing, landing page tools, CRM, checkout, analytics, marketing automation and adjacent categories (~21 category checkboxes on the form)
$19 one-time payment via Gumroad (basit313.gumroad.com/l/funnel-directory-featured-listing); alternative submission via Tally form (tally.so/r/obK4LV)
Form fields: tool name, email, tool link, categories, full details (Hero Title, Hero Description, Best For, Features, Pros, Cons, Pricing), competitive positioning ('Your Edge')
preparation: Write-up: hero title/description, best-for, features, pros/cons, pricing tiers
Competitive positioning: 1–2 competitor tools in the directory to be compared against
Optional: affiliate URL — the form asks for it
workflow: Open https://funneldirectory.com/submit and fill the form (or the Tally alternative)
Complete the $19 Gumroad purchase — note says 'Once Approved, pay on Gumroad to complete your listing'
Editorial team reviews and publishes within 12–48 hours; you receive the live URL by email
Listing: 30 days featured on homepage, then permanent in the directory; includes dedicated SEO review page, up to 2 comparison pages, up to 4 category placements
Updates later: email funneldirectory02@gmail.com — free within 24 hours
watchFor: Niche directory — only funnel/marketing tools; general SaaS doesn't fit
Young site ('Vol. 1 • Est. 2026', '30+ Tools Listed') — small audience, value is mostly the niche backlink/coverage
No recurring fees is a plus; updates are free via email
Contact is a gmail address — solo-operator scale
countsAsLive: A dedicated tool page at funneldirectory.com/funnel-builders/<slug> (or category placement) exists and the tool appears in the directory/homepage featured section
unknowns: Whether affiliate URLs get preferential placement
